title: Separation in Everyday Life
summary: Hand-picking, winnowing, sieving, churning, sedimentation, decantation, filtration, evaporation and magnets: choosing the right method by looking at properties.

ib.note: Revisited in MYP 3 with a focus on justifying the choice of method

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 9: Methods of Separation in Everyday Life
Ch 2: Is Matter Around Us Pure?, separation section

objectives: I can describe common separation methods used at home and on farms.
I can choose a separation method by identifying the property that differs (size, weight, magnetism, solubility).
I can plan a multi-step separation of a mixture of three substances.
misconceptions: Filtering can remove dissolved salt from water.
Evaporation lets you keep both the salt and the water.
One method works for every mixture.
